title: Trail Crew Member
organization: Wood River Trails Coalition, U.S. Forest Service
description: A six-month seasonal trail crew member position, funded by the WRTC and reporting to the US Forest Service Ketchum Ranger District. We were a mostly-front-country crew maintaining trails in the Wood River Valley. We also worked several backcountry camping hitches in the summer.
duties: Utilizes chainsaws and handsaws for brushing and bucking logs and hangups in the trail corridor
Maintains tread and drainage using picks, shovels, and hoes
Services chainsaws and hand tools and reports inventory needs
Operates company trucks and mountain bikes
Hikes up to 10 miles per day to perform trail maintenance
Project work includes rock retainers, bridge construction, and drainage features
Uses ArgGIS Field Maps to document and locate trail maintenance needs
Assists with volunteer trail work events
